$description: Console BLACK theme: the dark theme on true black, for OLED screens and dark rooms. Built on top of theme.dark.tokens.json (tokens/build.mjs loads the two, this file second) and emitted to the .dark.black block of src/styles/tokens.css, so every dark style still applies and only these values change: the sheet is #000, surfaces rise one step at a time, hairlines stay faint, text is #ededed and muted text #8a8a8a, and the soft fills are darkened so every text token still holds at least 4.5:1 on them. The brand orange and the status colours are the dark theme's. Pinned by src/styles/tokens.test.ts with the same 250 required pairs as the other themes.

frame.$description: Window frame: black, as the sheet.

surface.$description: A panel on the sheet: one step up.

raised.$description: Menus, popovers and cards that float: the second step.

text-3.$description: Tertiary text: as muted, the floor that keeps 4.5:1 on every fill.

accent-soft.$description: The orange's soft fill, dark enough for muted text on it.

diff-add.$description: An added line in a diff.

diff-del.$description: A removed line in a diff.

muted.$description: The muted fill, as the selected row.
